newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL MORTGAGE ISSUES EQUITY-LINKED DRACHMA NOTE.
newsitem.headline: NATL MORTGAGE ISSUES EQUITY-LINKED DRACHMA NOTE.

text.p: is issuing a one-year 3.0 percent drachma
equity-linked note based on a basket of six Athens stock
exchange blue-chip stocks, sources at the issuer told Reuters.
Sigma Securities is the arranger of the issue with NIBID

Moreover, the note will offer an innovative lock-in facility
for predetermined returns. Put differently, investors will have
the option upon purchase to pick among the following four
lock-in thresholds: open (no cap), 15, 20 and 25 percent.
Sources said the note is a "capital-guaranteed-plus-coupon
product" as investors will not experience losses in case the
The note is designed for the conservative investor who would
like to tap the stock market's high returns without taking on
the risk associated with direct investment in equities.
Another attractive feature is the interest rate downtrend in
Greece which is expected to bring yields down to single digits.
